milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because cobblestone_wall drops itself when mined with a pickaxe, and the player starts with no cobblestone_wall in inventory. The iron pickaxe provided can mine this block. min_count=1 ensures at least one wall block was mined.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the yellow glazed terracotta and face it. Target is the center of the terracotta cluster at spawn-relative [0, 0, 8]. max_distance=5 ensures the player has entered the room (impossible without first mining the wall). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the terracotta.
